recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is for FHIR-17982. No follow-up is needed unless Financial Management later decides to replace the legacy polling/REST guidance with a different workflow in a separate issue.
issue_request: FHIR-17982 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ExplanationOfBenefit change request asking to add documentation on how to obtain EOBs from a payor. It was raised for STU3, applied for STU3, and marked non-substantive by Financial Management.
initial_application: Git commit 96ee4c7ff55abe91e3c9e496f4eda7609be542ba, whose subject lists GF #17982 with related financial trackers, applied the request by adding an ExplanationOfBenefit introduction bullet saying EOBs may be obtained using Polling or FHIR REST (SEARCH) and by adding the real-time anchor to source/financial-module.html. The financial module also contains the Request an Explanation of Benefits polling use case.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ExplanationOfBenefit as an active FM resource with the eob abbreviation, so the EOB introduction is current build input. source/financial-module.html is the current Financial Module source page and includes the ExplanationOfBenefit resource item. Later source history normalized payor to payer and changed patient health record wording to Personal Health Record, but those edits did not remove or contradict the EOB-obtainment guidance. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source already tells implementers that EOBs can be obtained using Polling or FHIR REST (SEARCH), and the linked financial module explains deferred responses via GET/SEARCH or Poll and includes a Task-based Request an Explanation of Benefits use case.

related_jiras.note: Terminology-only reconciliation updated Personal Health Record wording in the same EOB surrounding text without altering the EOB-obtainment guidance.
Source history made payer the standard spelling, explaining why current source no longer uses the issue summary's payor spelling.
